Hi Sophie — thanks for the clear list. TL;DR answers up front: prompts are ephemeral by default and not used for model training unless a customer explicitly opts in via a written agreement; we can produce an auditable export and a redaction sample. Details and attachments below.

Quick summary to map to SCCs:
- Storage location & retention: Prompts are stored in an ephemeral request buffer in our serving layer and persisted to encrypted audit logs for debugging/forensics only. Default retention for debugging logs is 30 days; retention configurable to shorter windows per contract.
- Use for training: By default, customer data is excluded from any training/derivation pipelines. Any use for model improvement requires a signed data-use addendum (we provide an opt-in flow and an AR/POC).
- Minimization & redaction: We support PII redaction and provide tooling to perform deterministic redaction before logs are persisted. See attached redaction-script.py and an audit-log-sample.csv (sanitized).

Attachments included: redaction-script.py (example), audit-log-sample.csv (sanitized sample).

Hi all,

Adding technical detail for Eurosure's security annex and clause mapping:

1) Ingestion & ephemeral handling
- Incoming prompts are handled by the inference runtime in-memory; a KV cache (session-level) exists to service multi-turn chats but is isolated per-customer and TTLed.

2) Persistence & logs
- We persist two categories: (a) structured audit logs (request metadata, hashed prompt fingerprint, processing trace) retained by default for 30 days; (b) optional full request/response capture used only when customers enable "capture mode" for troubleshooting. Capture mode is off by default.
- All persisted logs are encrypted at rest (AES-256) and access controlled via RBAC; access is logged.

3) Training & model improvement
- Redwood's hosted service does not incorporate customer prompts into public training sets by default. Any training/derivation requires an explicit contractual opt-in under our Data Use Addendum. This includes any internal experiments that would use customer text.

4) Redaction & evidence
- We provide a deterministic redaction utility (attached) that replaces detected PII tokens with stable placeholders; redaction runs as a pre-persist step or can be applied on exported logs.
- We can produce an audit export (CSV or JSONL) showing timestamps, hashed prompt IDs, and redaction markers for forensic review. See sample attached (audit-log-sample.csv).

5) SCC/contract mapping suggestions
- Clause for retention limits: "Company shall retain Customer Request Logs for no longer than X days unless Customer requests otherwise in writing."
- Clause for training opt-in: "Company shall not use Customer Data to train or improve models without prior written consent provided via a Data Use Addendum."

Action items: Lauren / Marcus to propose formal wording for the annex and a short DPA addendum. I've raised SUP-1243 to track the legal template work.

Regards,
